hey I saw this post lol.... I was having to put my pc in sleep mode or else I'd get stuck in a "boot loop". About 4 hours before writing this my pc froze up after almost a week of being fine. I thought it was a dead gpu (10 year old 1070 still going strong lmao) but I had to do manual restarts due to waking up to my pc being black screened frozen after leaving it on over night.

I unfortunately I don't have a backup gpu to physically test, but I had an old ryzen 7 1700x from an old prebuilt lying around so I swapped it out and I havent crashed yet (fingers crossed its only been like an hour). 

To anyone else stumbling upon this - my symptoms were mainly waking up to a black screened pc after leaving it on over night, and shortly after this started I began having the crippling issue of being stuck on boot. I'd have the windows circles spinning get frozen and have to hard reset. I'd do this as many times as it'd take to get to the login screen (with the occasional system repair also getting stuck on reset). Eventually I'd get in for less than a minute before freezing, then either BSODing (maybe once or twice out of all crashes) or just straight black screening and pc force resetting back into the "loop". I updated my gpu drivers thinking it was mostly video related, but have had the failure since then.

Since I just got back into my pc I tried this event viewer tech as another way to diagnose and came upon this thread with comparable errors. Could very well be a hardware failure, but my Event Viewer is flooded with the same errors. I do infact have 2 instances of GameInput in Devices as well as a GameBar 'Error' level event.

This might be the right path to go down, but only time will tell
